translation: One text says: The spleen's sign is in the u瞼u (eyelid); when the eyelid moves, one knows the spleen can digest. When the spleen is diseased, the eyelid is rough and one is drowsy and sleeps excessively. These several statements all discuss the opening and closing of the eyes and sleeplessness; although they do not mention the two qiao vessels, they still do not depart from the principle of the deficiency and excess of yin-yang and nutritive-defensive [qi].
